module: Data streams sent to the UI (HUD apps) at high frequency. Each stream has a name (wheelInfo, engineInfo, stats, electrics, sensors, environment, genericGraphAdvanced…); the UI indicates which ones it needs via setRequiredStreams, and only those are computed then queued with guihooks.queueStream. Accessible as the global `streams` (main.lua: streams = require('guistreams')). guihooks.lua calls streams.update() when sending.
usage:
if streams.willSend('myStream') then
  guihooks.queueStream('myStream', {value = 42})
end
streams.drawGraph('speed', electrics.values.wheelspeed)
notes: willSend(name) is true only if guihooks.updateStreams (computed in main.lua:onGraphicsStep = active streams AND obj's UI refresh flag) is true and the stream is requested: useful to avoid building data needlessly.
hasActiveStreams() returns true as long as setRequiredStreams has never been called (as a precaution at startup), then only if at least one stream remains requested.

wheelInfo: per wheel, numerically indexed array: [1] name, [2] radius, [3] wheelDir, [4] angular velocity, [5] propulsionTorque, [6] lastSlip, [7] 0 (obsolete), [8] downForce, [9] brakingTorque, [10] brakeTorque, [11..13] static wheel center x,y,z, [14] offset along the axis, [15] rotatorType ('wheel' by default), [16] parkingTorque. The per-wheel tables are reused (cache).

sensors: gx, gy, gz, gx2, gy2, gz2, forceAtWheelNorm, forceAtDriverNorm, curForceLimitNorm, torqueCurrent (hydros), position {x,y,z}, roll, pitch, yaw, gravity. environment: temperature (K), pressure (obj:getEnvPressure). stats: obj:calcBeamStats() + tri_count + collidable_tri_count. engineInfo: controller.mainController.engineInfo. electrics: electrics.values.
The streamsHandlers table (one function per stream) is local and is not exported in M; only reset, update, setRequiredStreams, willSend, hasActiveStreams and drawGraph are.
drawGraph sends the 'genericGraphAdvanced' stream with a frame counter _fidx that increments on each call and the value of each key k.

willSend.desc: Indicates whether a stream must be sent this frame (stream requested by the UI and sending active).

returns.desc: True if the stream must be produced (may return nil/false otherwise).

reset.desc: Clears the requested streams and the cache of static wheel positions.

update.desc: Called by guihooks when sending the streams: runs the handler of each requested stream (those of streamsHandlers), which queues its data.

setRequiredStreams.desc: Sets the list of streams requested by the UI (replaces the previous one). Called by the engine/the UI.

hasActiveStreams.desc: Indicates whether at least one stream is requested (or whether the list has never been set). Used by main.lua:onGraphicsStep.

drawGraph.desc: Adds a value to the UI's advanced generic graph ('genericGraphAdvanced' stream), if this stream is requested.

streamsHandlers.desc: Local (non-exported) table of stream handlers, one argument-less function per stream name; update() calls them.

wheelInfo.desc: Builds and queues the 'wheelInfo' stream (see notes for the per-wheel format).

stats.desc: Queues obj:calcBeamStats() completed with tri_count and collidable_tri_count.

sensors.desc: Queues accelerations, steering wheel forces, position, roll/pitch/yaw and gravity.
